svg.aria-label: Three ways to split a time series: random days, a single cutoff with a gap, and TimeSeriesSplit folds whose training windows grow and whose test windows always come later

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family:inherit; text-anchor: start; fill: var(--ink,#272727)

g.text: Random split: test days scattered among training days (interpolation, too optimistic)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family:inherit; text-anchor: start; fill: var(--ink,#272727)

g.text: Time split with a gap: train on the past, skip a gap, test on the future

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family:inherit; text-anchor: middle; fill: var(--muted,#6b6b6b)

g.text: time (one block = one day) — blue: train, orange: test, blank: gap

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family:inherit; text-anchor: start; fill: var(--ink,#272727)

g.text: TimeSeriesSplit(n_splits=3, gap=2): expanding training window, each fold tests later
